name: GCRA
summary: The token bucket kept as a single theoretical arrival time. Identical decisions, one integer per key instead of three, which is why network gear and Redis modules use it.

source.title: The ATM Forum Traffic Management Specification, version 4.0 (generic cell rate algorithm)

complexity.space: O(k) for k keys, one integer each

params.name: burst
params.description: How many permits may be spent at once after an idle period.

notes: Admits and refuses exactly what the token bucket does, including the fractional carry, with retryAfter agreeing to the millisecond. A vector mirrors the token bucket case for case and a cross-policy test checks it over a random trace. The arithmetic is scaled by ratePerSec so the emission interval never needs to be a fraction.
